$comment: Example CMakePresets.json for a C++23 CLI (pixi + CMake + Ninja). /setup copies it to CMakePresets.json and substitutes MANGADEX_DL.
Schema v10 (CMake >= 3.31) is the first with $comment. No $schema URL is hardcoded: it is version-specific; pin one at /setup only if your editor wants it.
Build dirs are keyed by pixi env: build/<env>/<preset>. Run presets through pixi (`pixi run test`), never bare cmake: outside pixi PIXI_ENVIRONMENT_NAME and CONDA_PREFIX are empty.

No preset here sets `jobs`. Per-worktree caps live in the untracked CMakeUserPresets.json as `<preset>-local` presets (written by /features) which scripts/preset.sh selects. Never set CMAKE_BUILD_PARALLEL_LEVEL/CTEST_PARALLEL_LEVEL: CLI -j > env > preset jobs.
Workflow presets `dev`/`release` are conveniences for humans; the pixi tasks drive configure/build/test separately so the per-worktree cap applies.

configurePresets.name: base
$comment: Conda activation exports CXXFLAGS/LDFLAGS (-O2 -march=..., an rpath into the env) and CMake seeds the flag cache from them on first configure.

Every preset therefore sets CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS and BOTH linker flag variables explicitly (empty = no leak); presets pass them as -D on every configure, and the pixi tasks also blank CXXFLAGS/LDFLAGS. scripts/preset.sh fails a configure whose cache still shows leak markers (fix: `pixi run configure --fresh`).

configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.$comment: The everyday sanitized build. RPATH points into the pixi env so the installed E2E binary uses the env's libstdc++, not the host's (verified at /setup with readelf -d / ldd).

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.displayName: release: -O2, hardened, static libstdc++/libgcc (app), no RPATH, -Werror
configurePresets.$comment: The shippable build (default/clang env only). CMakeLists.txt links the app (only) with -static-libstdc++ -static-libgcc when MANGADEX_DL_HARDENING is ON; test executables stay dynamic for conda's shared-only Catch2. release-check gates: PIE, RELRO, BIND_NOW, NX stack, no RPATH/RUNPATH, NEEDED allowlist, glibc floor.

configurePresets.name: cov
configurePresets.displayName: cov: Debug -O0 -g, clang source-based coverage, unsanitized
configurePresets.$comment: Clang only (scripts/cov.sh skips it in the gcc env). Report-only; never part of `check`.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.$comment: Threaded tool (Project specifics). TSan and ASan never share a build; run via `nice pixi run tsan`. Not part of `check`.

testPresets.name: test-base
testPresets.$comment: No `jobs` here: scripts/preset.sh passes -j $(nproc) unless a `<preset>-local` test preset carries the per-worktree cap.

packagePresets.name: release
packagePresets.$comment: Run via `pixi run package` (scripts/package.sh refuses sanitized builds and non-default envs). Output lands in build/default/release/.
